name: @ubiquity/permit2-rpc-manager
author: 0x4007
description: Monorepo for Permit2 RPC Proxy Service and Client SDK

scripts.chainlist:generate: cd lib/chainlist && mkdir -p out && bash ../../scripts/generate-chainlist-file.sh && (bun run generate-json.js || bun run ../../scripts/generate-chainlist-rpcs-fallback.mjs)
scripts.whitelist:update: bun run chainlist:generate && bun run scripts/update-whitelist.mjs
scripts.test:client:local: cd packages/permit2-rpc-client && DISABLE_RPC_CACHE=true TEST_TARGET_URL=http://localhost:8000 bun test
